tickets.title: Fixed Sidebar Layout
tickets.description: Uses CSS flexbox utility classes (`d-flex`, `flex-column`, `vh-100`) to build a fixed sidebar next to a scrolling main content area.
tasks: Uses CSS flexbox utility classes (`d-flex`, `flex-column`, `vh-100`) to build a fixed sidebar next to a scrolling main content area.
tickets.evaluation: `check_class_used("vh-100")` `check_class_used("flex-shrink-0")` `check_class_used("flex-grow-1")` **[A] Visual (40 pts)**: 40 pts if the sidebar spans 100% of the viewport height without scrolling the body. **[B] Logic (40 pts)**: 40 pts for utilizing Bootstrap flex-grow/shrink utilities instead of custom CSS. **[C] Quality (10 pts)**: 10 pts for `nav-pills` usage for sidebar links.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to wrap .col elements in a .container and .row.
Using col-12 on desktop instead of a specific breakpoint like col-md-4.
hints: Remember that Bootstrap uses a 12-column grid system.
Make sure columns are wrapped inside a .row class.

tickets.title: Sass Variable Override Simulation
tickets.description: Writes Sass code to override the default primary color and border-radius before importing Bootstrap.
tasks: Writes Sass code to override the default primary color and border-radius before importing Bootstrap.
tickets.evaluation: `check_regex_match(r"\$primary:\s*#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6}")` `check_regex_order(["$primary", "@import"])` **[B] Logic (80 pts)**: 80 pts for declaring the override variables *before* the `@import` statement.
